PSG remain without Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, who is sidelined for the rest of the season, while Ousmane Dembele is also set to miss Tuesday’s trip to Spain. The visitors' defensive absences could include Marquinhos and Nuno Mendes, who are both expected to be unavailable.

Villarreal: Gulacsi; Mourino, Navarro, Veiga, Cardona; Gueye, Comesana; Buchanan, Pepe, Moleiro; Mikautadze.

PSG: Safonov; Hakimi, Zabarnyi, Pacho, Hernandez; Neves, Vitinha, Ruiz; Akliouche, Torres, Doue. [...] Gerard Moreno is a major doubt for Villarreal after being forced off during Saturday’s defeat to Espanyol. Ilias Akhomach and Nathan Saliba are also expected to miss out, although Pape Gueye is back in contention after serving a domestic suspension at the weekend. [...] UEFA Champions League, KO: 20:00 , Estadio de la Ceramica

Paris Saint-Germain

Paris Saint-Germain will look to preserve their perfect start to their Champions League title defence when they visit Villarreal on Tuesday night, with Luis Enrique’s side targeting a fourth straight victory.

Having conquered the continent in each of the last two seasons, the Parisians already look likely to be in the mix when next year’s final is played at the Estadio Metropolitano.
